places.name: City Centre Arena (planned)
places.text: On September 10, 2026, the City of Surrey reported that demolition had begun at the site of the planned 10,000-seat City Centre Arena at 10355 King George Boulevard. The City gives 2030 as the planned opening. Planned venue; not open to visitors.
